name: StackPerch 0.1.0 Preview (formerly KeepAny)
body:
StackPerch 原名 KeepAny，是独立开发者的本地数字资产工作台，把项目、域名、账号、订阅和维护事项关联起来。此预发布统一了中英 README、官网、应用、PWA 图标与名称，以及便携包名称；不扩展商业功能。

StackPerch, formerly KeepAny, is a local digital asset workspace for independent developers. This preview unifies the Chinese and English README, website, app, PWA branding and portable download name. It adds no commercial features.

## 试用 / Try it

下载本页的 `StackPerch-…-portable.zip`，解压到固定文件夹。需要 **Node.js 22+**，无需 Git、pnpm 或源码编译。

Download the `StackPerch-…-portable.zip` attached here and extract it to a fixed folder. **Node.js 22+** is required; Git, pnpm and source compilation are not required.

| 系统 / OS | 启动 / Start | 停止 / Stop |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | `start.command` | `stop.command` |
| Linux | `./start.sh` | `./stop.sh` |
| Windows | `start.bat` | `stop.bat` |

打开 / Open [http://127.0.0.1:4180/](http://127.0.0.1:4180/)。服务仅监听本机；关闭浏览器不会停止服务。端口被占用时先核查原服务。新用户可从空白概览使用示例资料，无需注册。

The server listens on loopback only. Closing the browser does not stop it. Check the existing service if the port is occupied. New users can start with sample records from the empty overview without creating an account.

## KeepAny 用户升级 / Upgrading from KeepAny

旧仓库、官网、问题反馈和旧测试版入口保留。本次改名不改变本地资料位置；继续使用原浏览器和同一个地址。旧 `.ka1` 加密备份及 `.kdbx` 密码库可继续使用，仍需原密码。

The existing repository, website, issue tracker and previous preview remain available. The rename preserves the local data location: use the same browser and exact origin. Existing `.ka1` encrypted backups and `.kdbx` vaults remain compatible and still require their original passwords.

升级前先下载并验证备份，保存编辑，关闭旧标签并停止旧服务，再启动新版。已验证旧发布版的同源资产、原图、语言设置、KDBX 字段、加密导入草稿保留与独立备份恢复；全部历史升级路径尚未穷举。

Before upgrading, download and verify a backup, save edits, close old tabs and stop the old service. Then start the new package. Tests cover same-origin preservation of assets, original images, language preference, vault fields and encrypted import drafts, plus restore into a separate profile. Every historical upgrade path has not been tested.

- [中文官网 / Chinese website](https://syndred.github.io/StackPerch/zh/)
- [English website](https://syndred.github.io/StackPerch/)
- [试用指南 / Trial guide](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/blob/main/docs/试用指南.md)
- [旧测试版 / Previous preview](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/releases/tag/v0.1.0-preview.20261011)

## 测试版边界 / Preview limits

本地核心采用 **AGPL-3.0-only** 开源，未来可选付费托管，当前官方托管与付费服务未开放。本地读写与完整导出不以付费为条件。AI 为可选能力，需自行配置提供商或兼容服务。此版本仍是早期测试版；真实手机、全部浏览器、真实模型服务及断电场景未全部验证。

The local core is open source under **AGPL-3.0-only**. Optional paid hosting is planned; official hosting and paid services are not available. Local read/write access and full export do not require payment. AI is optional and requires your own provider or compatible service. This is an early preview; physical phones, every browser, real model services and power-loss cases are not all verified.

公开页面提供品牌、产品说明和机器可读信息；这些信息不保证搜索收录或 GPT 推荐。

The public pages include product and machine-readable information. This does not guarantee search indexing or GPT recommendations.

## 验证 / Validation

源码 / Source: `cd12c582e4052f24a07aa38a9193a41be8b57380`

下载 / Asset: `StackPerch-0.1.0-preview.cd12c582e405-portable.zip`

SHA-256: `3cea76c1334a0af7133254c749e872a94779f49e9f9b07aa5b85f1ab90e73dd7`

同一源码提交的发布门禁 / Release gates for the same source commit:

- 792 unit tests with isolated PostgreSQL; fixed bundle 187 workflows; portable bundle 187 workflows.
- Native package verification on Linux, macOS and Windows.
- Real synchronization, offline checklist, published KeepAny data/vault upgrade and backup restore.
- Local bilingual onboarding and native storage-quota recovery; separate synthetic binding and official synchronization acceptance.
- [Local release CI](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/actions/runs/38337915628) · [Three-platform package CI](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/actions/runs/38337915644)

首次异常及不同验收配置的实际执行口径保留在 [验证记录](https://github.com/Syndred/StackPerch/tree/main/docs/evidence/2026-10-13/stackperch)，未将条件跳过或诊断复测改记成原始全量成功。

Initial failures and the execution scopes of each test configuration remain in the verification records; conditional skips and diagnostic runs are recorded separately.

反馈时请附系统、浏览器、版本和可复现步骤，使用虚构资料，不上传真实密码、API Key 或备份。

For feedback, include the OS, browser, version and reproduction steps using fictional data. Do not upload passwords, API keys or backup files.
